name: MuBank bonds MU and MUG at the live pair quote
summary: MuBank.mu_bond and mu_gold_bond sell the bank's MU and MUG for an approved stablecoin at a quote computed from the live reserves of the Trader Joe USDC.e/MU and MU/MUG pairs. Inside a flash swap of nearly all MU in the MU/MUG pair, the attacker dumped that MU into the USDC.e/MU pair, then bonded 3,300 and 6,990 USDC.e. The bank paid 99,102.20 MU and 9,640.24 MUG, about seven hours after deployment.

loss.notes: MuBank's MU and MUG paid out in the exploit transaction. The attacker's disposal moved both prices, so both are valued at realised proceeds. The final sale of 259,460.063432951156943008 MU returned 57,659.463903 USDC.e, which is 0.222229 USD per MU with USDC.e at par (DefiLlama 0.99949). MUG is valued through its sale for 180,974.292926286893962912 MU, which is 18.7728 MU per MUG. That gives 62,241.03 USD gross. The 10,290 USDC.e the attacker paid into the bank for the two bonds is netted. The attacker's MU round trip through the USDC.e/MU pair is a cost borne by pair LPs and is not counted. DefiLlama's pre-exploit MU spot of 0.645 USD is not used because the disposal moved the price. The seed row and DeFiHackLabs give ~57k USD, the attacker's USDC.e profit.

ageReset.description: Owner setMuMoneyAddress(0x1713bcaf63fd615f4fde8d025326ce0948ebccdb). Both bond functions end with MuMoneyMinter(_MuMoney).mint(address(this), amount). The constructor default 0x5ea63080e67925501c5c61b9c0581dbd87860019 reverts that mint for the bank with "Only the Mu Bank can mint new Mu Money", so the bond path worked only after this write.

sources.note: Root cause, target and anchor. Verified source of MuBank 0x4aa679402c6afce1e0f7eb99ca4f09a30ce228ab (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode, chainid=43114, contracts/MuBank.sol, v0.8.9): _mu_bond_quote reads getReserves of USDC.e/MU pair 0xfacb3892f9a8d55eb50fdeee00f2b3fa8a85ded5 and returns (getAmountIn + getAmountOut) / 2 MU for the stable amount; _get_mug_bond_quote converts that MU amount through the live MU/MUG pair 0x67d9aab77beda392b1ed0276e70598bf2a22945d reserves the same way. The pair addresses and router are hardcoded, and there is no TWAP or bound. Source-1 (block 23435295, index 0) logs: attack contract 0xe6c17763 flash-swaps 578987.936812388669434540 MU from the MU/MUG pair (log 0), sells it to the USDC.e/MU pair for 85123.535028 USDC.e (logs 3-4), mu_bond(USDC.e, 3300e18) pays 3300 USDC.e and receives 99102.201128573810201054 MU (logs 8, 10), mu_gold_bond(USDC.e, 6990e18) pays 6990 USDC.e and receives 9640.237839603403398058 MUG (logs 12, 14), then it buys back MU, repays the flash swap, sells MUG and sends 57659.463903 USDC.e to EOA 0xd46b44a0 (log 33). Age: eth_getTransactionReceipt(source-2).contractAddress = MuBank (block 23422785, index 8, creator 0xf243d799); eth_getCode empty at 23422784; keccak256(runtime) = 0x074c06c9bda0f2f8c234d42d4c989981009fd11a2d7256af35941fa7c84d885e at 23422785 and 23435294; not a proxy. Slot 8 (_MuMoney) changed 0x5ea63080... -> 0x1713bcaf... in source-3 (23422908, index 3). eth_call mint(MuBank, 1) from MuBank at block 23435294 reverts on 0x5ea63080 ("Only the Mu Bank can mint new Mu Money") and succeeds on 0x1713bcaf. The Etherscan txlist of MuBank up to the exploit has only owner calls: recoverTokens, setMuMoneyAddress, stable_coin_bond and redeem_mu_money. eth_getLogs of MU and MUG Transfer events from/to MuBank for blocks 23422785-23435400 show only owner funding (100000 MU at 23423195, 10000 MUG at 23423202, 1 MUG in and out), and the exploit's payouts. Source-1 is the first bond payout.
